effect.target: Prevent lost updates under same-version simultaneous clients
effect.hypothesis: BEGIN IMMEDIATE plus expected version permits exactly one change/history row
effect.baseline: Sequential stale update had passed; simultaneous clients unverified
effect.conditions: Two real urllib clients and two browser contexts, barrier release, same original fixture, real loopback backend and SQLite; browser interception forwards unchanged actual requests/responses
effect.observations: HTTP and browser races each produce one200/one409; one new history row each, version2 state, persistent after restart; loser UI shows latest state and explicit conflict. One harness callback repair retained.
limits: One race per client type, not load/performance proof

next_action: Integrate final acceptance results without publishing until the user gate is fully satisfied.
